lines: Be-sabab baat badhaane ki zaroorat kya hai?
couplets.en: Why make more of this than need be?

lines: Hum khafa kab the, manaane ki zaroorat kya hai?
couplets.en: When was I ever cross with you, that you should try to make amends?

lines: Aap ke dam se to duniya ka bharam hai qaayam.
couplets.en: It is you who keeps the world's illusion alive.

lines: Aap jab hain to zamaane ki zaroorat kya hai?

lines: Tera koocha, tera dar, teri gali kaafi hai.
couplets.en: Your lane, your doorstep, your little street are enough for me.

lines: Be-thikaanon ko thikaane ki zaroorat kya hai?

lines: Dil se milne ki tamanna hi nahin jab dil mein.
